title: Beautiful Area Rug
text:
Beautiful Area Rug. Looks great in my entry way and completely matches my color scheme. I'm happy with it except that it is not very heavy and the end curls up when we walk on that spot. Overall, I'm happy with it for the price I paid.

Edit: The curled up spot is easily fixable with double sided tape, which can be found in any hardware store. The tape that I bought is specifically for these type of carpets.
